sectionOrder: Cumberland Forest, Grizzlies, and Roanoke Ridge

notes.scope: Red Dead Redemption 2 Story Mode dinosaur-bone sites tied to A Test of Faith. Red Dead Online, Red Dead Redemption, and Undead Nightmare are excluded.
notes.rowUnit: One named collectible site, not a source ordinal, species, screenshot, or quest milestone.
notes.progressionNote: The first 22 sites use the normal Chapter 2+ route. The eight New Austin sites are marked post-story/epilogue for normal Story Mode access; exploit routes are excluded.
notes.namingNote: Canonical site names follow the approved Guides4Gamers roster. Conflicting guide ordinals and spelling variants are not public item identity.
notes.imagePolicy: The separate image pass must resolve exact-location image rights or approved replacement captures. No images are wired during this data pass, so every items[].system.image value is null.
